HANGS Construction Services LLC Contract S-2601
1200 Example Road, Anytown, WA 00000 Article 5 · Progress Payments (excerpt)
Project: Bellhaven Branch Library Renovation, job S-2601
The Owner retains 5% of each progress payment until substantial completion.
Materials stored off the site are paid only with a bill of sale, a certificate of insurance
covering the materials at the storage location and naming the Owner, and the Owner's written
approval. Materials stored on the site are paid when delivered, with the delivery ticket.
An application includes only change orders signed by the Owner.
Each application includes a conditional waiver for the amount applied for and an unconditional
waiver for the last payment received.
Applications are due on the 25th of the month for work through the end of the month, to the Owner
Invented document for a software demonstration. No real company, person, policy or account.
